note: Recast from the original description in Hagen 1858, Monographie der Termiten (Linnaea Entomologica 12, pp. 61—62), the original being a Latin diagnosis with a detailed German account. Hagen had only 1 poorly preserved specimen and described only the alate, not the soldier or the worker; the specimen came from St. Jao del Rey, Brazil, collected by Sellow and held in the Berlin museum. The original places it in Calotermes (Calotermes nodulosus), now referred to Rugitermes. Hagen also pointed out that it may be confused with the black-thorax form of C. flavicollis, but with only 1 specimen he kept them separate on the characters described. The original writes "4£" for 4½, rendered here as 4.5 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Dark brown alate: head pitch black, shiny and polished, mouthparts pale yellow, antenna yellow but with a brown basal segment, pronotum yellow, shiny and polished, the dorsum of the body leather-coloured, the whole venter together with the femora brown, the rest of the legs pale yellow; wings yellowish brown and lacquer-like, the horny marginal veins and the wing scales dark brown. It is close to C. brevis in form, but the head is slightly wider, nearly square, rounded posteriorly and truncate and depressed anteriorly; the compound eyes are slightly smaller and less projecting; the pronotum is slightly narrower than the head and its posterior angles are much more rounded, so that it narrows distinctly posteriorly.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pitch black, shiny and polished; mouthparts pale yellow; antenna yellow, the basal segment brown; pronotum yellow, shiny and polished; maxillary palps brownish; dorsum of the body leather-coloured, the whole venter together with the femora brown, the rest of the legs pale yellow; wings yellowish brown and lacquer-like, the horny marginal veins and the wing scales dark brown. The body is sparsely hairy. Close to C. brevis in form. Head slightly wider, nearly square, rounded posteriorly and truncate and depressed anteriorly; compound eyes slightly smaller and less projecting, with a small ocellus where their inner margins slightly diverge. Vertex with a shallow impression in which the Y suture is discernible. Antenna (only 10 segments preserved) stout, gradually thickening towards the tip, the basal segment longer, the two following segments as long as wide, all three cylindrical; then two slightly shorter ring-like segments, the remaining segments rather subspherical or elongate at the base. Maxillary palps short, hardly exceeding the mouth, stout; the terminal 3 segments especially stout, only slightly longer than wide, the last oval. Labial palps stout and short, segment 2 inversely conical, strongly widened towards the tip. Labrum as long as wide, projecting beyond the mandibles, the sides rounded, slightly widened anteriorly. Pronotum similar to that of C. brevis, slightly narrower than the head, the posterior angles much more rounded, so that it narrows strongly posteriorly; the anterior margin bends down distinctly towards the outer angles. Legs as in C. brevis; the tip of the hind tibia with 3 spurs; tarsal claws rather stout with a thick base, with a narrow truncate empodial lobe between them. The body is wider than the thorax; in the male the two anal cerci are close together and separated. Abdominal styli very small, nipple-like. Wings similar in shape and size to those of C. brevis, but the venation differs: the subcosta bends strongly at the base and lies far from the costa, with 7 oblique horny branches between them; the media joins the subcosta a short distance behind the wing scale; the submedia gives off 11 mostly unbranched branches. The hindwing is simpler: the subcosta arises as a single vein, the media appears to be absent, and the submedia has about 12 unbranched branches. The veins and the membrane between them are coarsely punctate, so that the wing appears scarred. The subcosta gives off an indistinct branch towards the media at the tip. Measurements: length with wings 10 mm, body length 4.5 mm, wingspan 16 mm.
